name: gatekeeper
description: Gatekeeper — an OAuth 2.1 / OpenID Connect identity provider built with NestJS and Next.js
author: Lalit Rajak (https://github.com/lalitkumarrajak)

scripts.generate: npm run build:shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @gatekeeper/api && npm run typegen -w @gatekeeper/web
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run build -w @gatekeeper/api && npm run build -w @gatekeeper/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate && npm run typecheck -w @gatekeeper/shared -w @gatekeeper/api -w @gatekeeper/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @gatekeeper/api && npm run test -w @gatekeeper/web
